newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian vet sews lips shut in hunger strike.
newsitem.headline: Indian vet sews lips shut in hunger strike.

text.p: An Indian vet on a hunger strike in protest against unemployment on Monday stitched his lips together to avoid being forcibly fed, the Press Trust of India said.
The news agency said Partha Pratim Kar, on strike for 17 days, had been without a job since he completed his training in 1991 in the northeastern state of Tripura.
Kar and 35 other vets are demanding jobs from the state government.
The news agency said the government recruited 38 people in 1995 under an affirmative action programme for lower Hindu castes, filling the vacancies.
